race_context: Eastern Greene Schools is a Greene County school district with an elementary school, a middle school, a high school and an Early Learning Center. Superintendent Doug Lewis signs its 2026-27 welcome letter {eg_welcome}{gcdw_seats}{eg_min260112}.

Doug Lewis was new to the superintendent's job in November 2024, when the Greene County Daily World reported on his early board meetings {gcdw_nov24}. In July 2026 the board approved his superintendent contract 5-0 {eg_min260713}.

The board has seven members: Scott Carmichael (president), Kim Waldridge (vice president), Sharon Abts (secretary), Mike Adams, Dennis Crowe, Natalie Crowe and Heather Hudson {eg_board}{eg_min260112}.

Four seats were elected at large in November 2024, won by Scott Carmichael, Heather M. Hudson, Natalie O. Crowe and Sharon C. Abts {gcdw_res24}. The 2026 ballot has three seats tied to townships: Beech Creek, Center and Jackson {gcdw_seats}{in_list}.

Of the three board members not elected in 2024, Dennis Crowe is running for the Center seat and Kim Waldridge for the Jackson seat. Mike Adams is not on the ballot. The sources reviewed do not say which township seat each member holds now {eg_board}{gcdw_res24}{gcdw_seats}{in_list}.

Two of the three races are uncontested: Marilyn Leanne Burch is the only candidate in Beech Creek and Kimberly Waldridge the only candidate in Jackson. Center is contested between Dennis Crowe (Republican) and Jason Carmichael (Independent) {in_list}{gcdw_seats}.

Facilities and debt: in October 2025 the board held a hearing on and adopted a resolution for a 2025 General Obligation Bond project. That fall it accepted bids for an Early Learning Center renovation, low-slope and shingled roof work, and high school ADA restroom parking. In April 2026 it approved bids under the high school bond and lease bond projects {eg_min251013}{eg_min251110}{eg_min260413}.

Superintendent Lewis's 2026-27 letter lists a new roof at the elementary and middle school, work at the high school on parking lots, HVAC controls and the track and field complex, and an expanded Early Learning Center {eg_welcome}.
Land: in October 2025 the board voted 6-0 to buy 29.5 acres directly north of the high school for $319,250 {eg_min251013}.

Budget: in October 2025 the board adopted the 2026 budget, capital projects plan and bus replacement plan. At the same meeting it authorized tax anticipation warrants for 2026 and moved $100,000 from the Operations Fund to the Rainy Day Fund {eg_min251013}. In June 2026 it hired Harmon Consulting for budget assistance and set a $25-per-season athletic transportation fee for athletes in grades 5-12. In August 2026 it voted 7-0 to advertise the 2027 budget {eg_min260608}{eg_min260810}. The minutes reviewed do not discuss the effect of the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1) or any referendum.

Planning and staffing: in June 2026 the board approved foundational statements for a strategic plan {eg_min260608}. It ratified the 2025-26 teachers' agreement in November 2025 {eg_min251110}, and in August 2026 it approved joining the ROI Ready Schools Cohort 5 {eg_min260810}.

No candidate forum, questionnaire or candidate profile for the 2026 Eastern Greene races was found. The Greene County Daily World listed the Eastern Greene seats and candidates on Sept. 18, 2026 {gcdw_seats}.
